description: Hi friends, Election Day is nearly 100 days away , and I need your help to connect with our community. Join Reps. Paul Evans, Tom Andersen, and me for a community canvass on Saturday, July 25 at 10:00 AM. We will be meeting at the Marion County Democrats Office (245 High St. NE, Salem, OR 97301).
